label: input j early in the original phase (t=2-4), boosted by first token 0/m/w or previous n/j
explanation: Very sparse unit (about 0.03% of steps). 99.7% of activation mass is on input token j during the original phase, almost all at t=2-5 (74% at t=3); it never fires at t=0-1, at t>=6, on the delimiter, or in the copy phase, and the only other token is v (2 activations). But j alone is a weak predictor: only about 3% of early-position j inputs activate it. Which j inputs fire depends on context. The largest activations come when the sequence starts with 0 (also m or w, d, s) or the previous token is n or j (e.g. 0 z n [j]). Restricting to t=2-4 and those contexts gets dev F1 about 0.31 with 87% mass recall; precision stays low (about 0.2), so the exact prefix condition is not captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=3 & in_tok=j (+3.61), orig0=0 (+3.37), t=2 & prev_tok=n (+2.96), prev_tok=n (+2.93), orig0=m (+2.62), prev_tok=j (+2.59). Lower it: prev2_tok=d (-1.67), orig0=1 (-1.66), prev2_tok=0 (-1.51), orig0=j (-1.46).
